description: Rules for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech.

defaultPrompt: Přepiš tento koncept podle Controlled Czech a vysvětli, která pravidla CCxxx jsi použil.
Zkontroluj tuto českou technickou dokumentaci podle Controlled Czech a navrhni konkrétní úpravy.
Napiš ADR v Controlled Czech: rozhodnutí, důvody, důsledky, alternativy.
interface.longDescription:
Controlled Czech is an open specification for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech, packaged as a skill. Use it when writing, editing or reviewing Czech documentation, specifications, ADRs, issues, pull request descriptions, runbooks and AI agent instructions.

Every rule has a stable identifier (CCxxx), so the agent can load a single rule instead of the whole specification and every suggestion can be traced back to it. Only the skill description enters the context up front; the full rules load when Czech text is actually being written.

The repository also ships a deterministic linter written in Go (controlled-czech check). It runs offline, uses no LLM and never rewrites text, so the same rules can gate documentation in CI with --fail-on-warning.

Not intended for marketing copy, fiction, personal communication or brand voice.

name: controlled-czech
